title: ever LIORÉ|Sparkling Short Sleeve V-Neck Ribbon Waist A-Line Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This sparkling bridesmaid dress offers the perfect blend of elegance and charm. The V-neckline and short sleeves create a flattering silhouette, while the ribbon waist adds a delicate touch. The A-line shape ensures comfort and movement, making it a stunning choice for bridesmaids seeking style and grace.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.

Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
